The Breakfast DinerReservoir DogsBreakfast first. Then the job.Every recipe serves 4.

    Before MidnightDiner silver dollar pancakesSmall buttermilk pancakes stacked in threes with butter and maple syrupHow to make it200g plain flour2 tsp baking powder1 tbsp caster sugar300ml buttermilk1 egg40g butter100ml maple syrupWhisk the flour, baking powder, sugar, buttermilk and egg.Rest.Cook small rounds in butter until bubbles set.Stack in threes with butter and maple syrup.Warehouse hash brownsPotato and onion cakes. The warehouse ends in a Mexican standoffHow to make it800g potatoes1 brown onion1 tsp fine salt40g butter2 tbsp vegetable oilGrate the potatoes and onion and squeeze dry.Season with fine salt and press into flat cakes.Fry in butter and oil until deep golden on both sides.Mr Pink's bacon and egg slidersMr Pink at the diner, who doesn't tipHow to make itNot on tonight's cookSoft scrambled eggs, crisp streaky bacon and melted American cheese in toasted brioche slider buns with hot sauce mayo.Grill 8 rashers streaky bacon until crisp and halve.Whisk 8 eggs with salt and scramble softly in 30g butter over low heat.Toast 8 brioche slider buns.Mix 4 tbsp mayo with 1 tbsp hot sauce.Fill each bun with egg, bacon, a half slice of American cheese and a spoon of the hot sauce mayo.The Night ShiftNice Guy Eddie's steak sandwichRump, onions, provolone. Are you gonna bark all day, little doggie?How to make it2 brown onions30g butter2 rump steaks4 bread rolls4 slices of provolone4 tbsp mayonnaise1 tbsp horseradishCook the sliced onions slowly in the butter until golden.Sear the steaks and rest.Mix the mayonnaise and horseradish and toast the rolls.Slice the steak and pile into rolls with onions and provolone.Joe Cabot's big breakfast plateTwo eggs your way, thick bacon, pork snags, crispy hash browns, buttered toast and blistered tomatoHow to make itNot on tonight's cookTwo eggs your way, thick-cut bacon, griddled pork sausages, crispy hash browns, buttered toast and a blistered tomato on a big oval plate.Grill 8 pork sausages for 15 minutes, turning.Fry 8 rashers thick-cut bacon.Halve 4 tomatoes and grill cut side down until blistered.Bake 8 hash browns at 220°C for 20 minutes.Fry 8 eggs in butter to order.Toast 8 slices of bread and butter well.Load everything onto four big plates with tomato sauce on the table.The Pie CaseLike a Virgin lemon meringue pieTart lemon curd in a sweet pastry case under toasted meringueHow to make it2 sheets of sweet shortcrust pastry400g caster sugar40g cornflour3 lemons4 eggs40g butter300ml waterBlind bake the pastry case at 180°C.Cook the water, part of the sugar, cornflour, lemon juice and zest and yolks until thick, then add the butter.Pour into the case.Whisk the egg whites with the remaining sugar to stiff peaks and pile on top.Bake until golden.Behind the CounterTip jar maple cream cold brewCold brew, maple cream. Mr Pink still won't throw in a dollarHow to make it100g coarse ground coffee1 L cold water150ml thickened cream2 tbsp maple syrup1 bag iceStir the coffee into the cold water and steep in the fridge for 12 hours.Strain.Whisk the cream with the maple syrup until just thick.Fill four mugs with ice, pour in the cold brew and spoon the maple cream on top.Fresh-squeezed grapefruit juiceK-Billy's Super Sounds of the Seventies, all weekend.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
